summary_text: This shopper is a routine-driven household manager focused on daily fresh consumables, anchored by a high-frequency 'staple triad' of Milk, Breads, and Vegetables. Brand loyalty is strong and specific within core categories (Chitale/Amul for milk, Britannia for bread, Aashirvaad for flour, Amul for butter/curd), while showing flexibility or trial behavior in non-core categories like spices, noodles, and snacks. Purchases are predominantly weekday morning events, reflecting a structured daily routine for meal preparation and breakfast components. The user prefers moderate basket sizes with low multi-quantity tendencies, favoring fresh, immediate-use items over bulk stock-ups. Ritual items (incense, flowers) and occasional snacks appear as secondary, non-bundled additions to the core grocery haul.
